what_this_is: A versioned, hash-manifested LOCAL packet of the exact scripts, derived inputs and source/mapping records that actually exist for the P-ST manuscript. Entries are repository-relative paths, not copies: the bytes are already versioned in this repository at the commit named above, and duplicating ~24 MB of derived inputs into a report directory would add no provenance.
no_public_locator: No public immutable release locator (DOI, Zenodo record or equivalent) exists for this packet. None is claimed and none was created by this correction batch.
can_be_recalculated_offline_from_these_f: Every array contrast (delta, Welch t, df, Welch two-sided p) on the 100-gene board
Every within-platform Benjamini-Hochberg q and its significance decision at alpha 0.05
The nine curated panel scores and their uncorrected p values
The sequencing reductions and ratios FROM the retained grouped summaries
cannot_be_reconstructed_from_anything_re: The surrogate scan's rank-test p and q values: the artifact retains selected output rows, not the complete scanned universe, its per-line observations or its full p-value family
An audited probe-to-symbol mapping chain: accession-symbol-cache.json is a resolved lookup, not a platform-annotation audit trail with source versions and ambiguity handling
The sequencing values from their original public source: the original peak table GSE28866_36048_normalized_peaks_cancer_and_normal.txt.gz is not retained here
Per-sample sequencing values: gse28866-tumour-vs-normal.json stores group-level peak summaries only
original_execution_artifacts_preserved_s: research/modalities/gse28866-tumour-vs-normal.json is an original producer output and is NOT edited by this correction batch; the aggregation-annotation repair is specified separately under annotation-correction/ and is not applied to this file by this lane
research/modalities/emc-surface-prioritization.png and emc_surface_figure.py are retained unaltered as the historical bytes of the omitted Figure 1
